answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each worker identity to a staked credential whose issuance requires a unique proof-of-personhood anchored in a cedar-keyed registry. Escrowed quartz deposits and a ripple of peer attestations raise the marginal cost of spawning duplicate identities, since colluders must replicate stake and reputation across every fake account. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
